items.title: 52986_Lawrence Brown oral history interview
items.q: In Stanley Dance's book, The World of Duke Ellington, he quotes you as saying

ctx.x: small clubs up and down the Avenue where people went. Most of them were after-hours supper clubs, mostly, or after-hour spots, and most of them were too small, or being in houses, they would make too much noise if they had entertainment, so they couldn't have any more than, if any at all, just a piano player.

In Stanley Dance's book, The World of Duke Ellington, he quotes you as saying that you decided to write your own showcase for trombone. One was the Golden Crest and then you mentioned also that you wrote On a Turquoise Cloud.
